description: Provision a Google Cloud Vertexai VertexAIMetadataStore via Config Connector. Fields mirror the vertexai.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 VertexAIMetadataStore spec.

enabledPipelinesLineage.description: Optional. Whether or not Data Lineage synchronization is enabled for Vertex Pipelines.

encryptionSpec.description: Customer-managed encryption key spec for a Metadata Store. If set, this Metadata Store and all sub-resources of this Metadata Store are secured using this key.

kmsKeyRef.description: Required. The Cloud KMS resource identifier of the customer managed encryption key used to protect a resource. The key needs to be in the same region as where the compute resource is created. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed KMSCryptoKey. Should be in the format `projects/[kms_project_id]/locations/[region]/keyRings/[key_ring_id]/cryptoKeys/[key]`.

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

projectRef.description: The project that this resource belongs to. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: The `projectID` field of a project, when not managed by Config Connector.

kind.description: The kind of the Project resource; optional but must be `Project` if provided.

region.description: The region of the Metadata Store. eg us-central1.

resourceID.description: The VertexAIMetadataStore name. If not given, the metadata.name will be used.

title: GCP Vertexai VertexAIMetadataStore
